name: Pycroft's Petrel
rangeDescription: Breeds small islands off new zealand coast; ranges to north pacific
description: Small gadfly petrel. Gray upperparts and head, with darker “M” across wings.

name: Chinese Gray Shrike
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern russia (amur region) to northeastern and central china
description: A beautiful silvery shrike with gray upperparts, white underparts, a black mask, and white in the wings. The white patches in the black wings and tail are especially conspicuous in flight.

name: Bare-throated Tiger-Heron
rangeDescription: Wet lowlands of coastal western and eastern mexico (from southern sonora and southern tamaulipas) southward through central america to far northwestern colombia (lower atrato valley), with an extremely disjunct population in northwestern peru
description: A large but rather short-legged, primal-looking heron of mangroves and freshwater marshes in tropical lowlands. Often in areas with trees, but also around ponds in rather open marshes.

name: White-necked Hawk
rangeDescription: Lowland forest of coastal southeastern brazil
description: Medium-sized pied hawk of dense Atlantic Forest. Note yellow bill base, white head and belly, and black back.

name: Elegant Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Southeastern new guinea
description: A fairly small honeyeater of lowland and foothill wooded habitats. Note the long, slender bill and large yellow ear spot curving around the back of the eye and edged with black.

name: Golden-winged Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Western highlands of vietnam (mount ngoc linh)
description: Restricted to high-elevation forest (above 2,000 meters) in the Annamite Mountains of central Vietnam. Predominantly gray with gold and rusty patches in the wings and tail.

name: Eastern Shrike-tit
rangeDescription: Southeastern australia (central queensland to southern victoria and southeastern south australia)
description: Small bird with short, heavy bill. Green above, yellow below, with bold black-and-white head pattern.

name: Dark Hawk-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Mountains of malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Large long-tailed cuckoo with a distinctly raptor-like appearance. As with most other hawk-cuckoos, often perches deep in tall trees; best detected by its song, a piercing and repetitive “wit-CHEW-WEE”.

name: Tanager Finch
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of western andes of colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Distinctive finch-like bird restricted to cloud forest Andes of western Colombia and northwestern Ecuador. Plumage is chestnut-brown with a black head and silvery stripes on face and crown.

name: St. Lucia Black Finch
rangeDescription: St. lucia (lesser antilles)
description: A small seed-eating species of forests with dense understory. Commonly found in pairs feeding on the ground.

name: Western Tragopan
rangeDescription: Himalayas of northern pakistan to northwestern india and adjacent southwestern tibet
description: A large, short-tailed pheasant. Male appears mostly dark with prominent white dots all over.

name: Bertram's Weaver
rangeDescription: Highlands of tanzania, zambia, malawi, and northern mozambique
description: Fairly large, chunky weaver. Both sexes have a pale eye, an olive back, and yellow underparts.

name: Snowy-crowned Tern
rangeDescription: Lagoons and marshes of southeastern brazil and uruguay to patagonia
description: Attractive but often rather local tern of southern South America. Favors shallow coastal waters, but also ranges inland locally along rivers and lakes.

name: Falcated Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Southwestern philippines (balabac and palawan)
description: A striking medium-sized bird of lowland and foothill forest floor or dense undergrowth on Palawan and Balabac. Often found near streams and gullies.

name: Beautiful Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Northern colombia (magdalena valley)
description: Medium-sized woodpecker endemic to northern Colombia. Strikingly patterned: black above and buffy below with bright red crown, yellow nape, black mask, barred flanks, and a white stripe down the back.

name: Hume's Boobook
rangeDescription: Andaman islands
description: A medium-sized, dark brown owl with distinctive yellow eyes. Note the small white spot between the eyes.

name: Sunda Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Western lesser sundas (lombok, sumbawa, and flores)
description: A plain, sparrow-sized honeyeater with a slender, downcurved bill like a sunbird’s. Entirely rich olive above, plain gray on face and throat, with a yellow wash on the underparts.

name: Javan Pied Starling
rangeDescription: Eastern sumatra (where possibly introduced), java, and bali; probably extinct in the wild
description: An exceedingly rare Javan endemic starling now probably extinct in the wild. Brownish mantle, black chest and upperparts, with white belly, rump, cheek and shoulder stripe.

name: Golden Bowerbird
rangeDescription: Highland rain forest of northeastern australia (northeastern queensland)
description: Small bowerbird restricted to higher-elevation rainforest in Northern Queensland. Male has stunning bright yellow underparts, yellowish-brown face, and dull yellowish back.

name: Yellow-throated Hanging-Parrot
rangeDescription: Java and bali
description: Tiny short-tailed parrot, endemic to Java and Bali. Leaf-green overall, with a bright red rump, pale eyes, and dainty orange bill.
